revisedMode: default reoptimize with bound skip; both arms receive budget 100
controls: Exactly the same 30 dense edited maps/current starts/goals/prior valid routes/order. Only per-call budget changes from 300 to 100. No sampling, editing, reference-route acquisition or method/policy change.
measurements: Separate usable routes from completed new A*, bound proofs and raw optimization budget failures. Preserve valid fallback and failed empty/null planningResult. Compare returned length to archived independent BFS, shorter-than-prior and missed potential shortening, work/call counts. Do not infer all usable routes mean all optimizations completed.
referenceChecks: If archived full search expanded <=100, original result fields should match. If >100, expect budget failure at exactly 100 and retain the prior valid route. Raw 300-budget results are not overwritten.
attribution: Student selected option 2 (offered 100 budget) only. AI supplies comparison analysis/tests/method/code/operation and initial interpretation.
scope: Same-known-cohort budget/fallback control; prior full-search counts are already available, not blind or an independent dataset. Static fully known four-neighbor unit cost, no motion/sensor/runtime/energy claim. Commit protocol/source before the budget-100 run.
